nodes.label: Executive Feed (themed view over pulse_posts)
nodes.rationale: not a rebuild - a filtered re-themed view over existing pulse_posts/pulseApi, the lowest-effort highest-leverage item in the entire spec

nodes.label: Opportunity Radar full screen
nodes.rationale: launches only with categories that have real backing; remaining categories shown greyed-out 'Coming soon' rather than hidden or faked

nodes.label: AI Matchmaking (cross-entity)
nodes.rationale: one consistent card pattern reused across 14 entity-pair types so it feels like one intelligent system rather than fourteen stitched-together features

nodes.label: Universal Search
nodes.rationale: no search endpoint or index exists anywhere in the codebase today; honest launch scoped to profiles/pulse_posts/jobs/problems, rest marked 'not yet searchable'

nodes.label: Following System (entity-follow schema gap)
nodes.rationale: follows.following_id today is a profiles.id FK; following a topic/technology needs a polymorphic or separate entity_follows table

nodes.label: Trending Intelligence
nodes.rationale: only Trending Founders (ELO+follow growth) and Trending Discussions (pulse_posts engagement) have real data; rest ship as Coming soon, never invented rankings

nodes.label: intelligence_matches generalized table proposal
nodes.rationale: broader than Funding Hub's investor-specific investor_matches, which should probably be a specialization of this table rather than a separate one
